meta.name: mnemos-memory
meta.description: Use when users or OpenClaw/ClawHub agents need to install, configure, self-bootstrap, troubleshoot, or operate Mnemos for persistent scoped agent memory, or when they mention Mnemos, agent memory, scoped memory, memory MCP tools, or memory automation.

copy.tagline: 安装、配置和运维持久化智能体记忆系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为智能体安装和管理持久化记忆系统
copy.tagline_en: Install, configure, and operate persistent agent memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to install and manage persistent memory for agents

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你安装和配置 Mnemos 记忆系统，并在任务开始时自动检索相关记忆、存储重要事实、在完成重要工作前整理记忆，还能检查记忆是否正确。
howto.when: 当你提到 Mnemos、agent memory、scoped memory、memory MCP tools 或 memory automation，或者需要安装、配置、排查 Mnemos 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 Mnemos 记忆系统。
在开始任务前，先检索相关记忆。
把这个事实存到记忆里。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to install and configure the Mnemos memory system, automatically retrieve relevant memories at task start, store important facts, consolidate memories before finishing substantial work, and inspect memories when something looks wrong.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Mnemos, agent memory, scoped memory, memory MCP tools, or memory automation, or when you need to install, configure, or troubleshoot Mnemos.

say_en.text: Help me install the Mnemos memory system.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through pip install and mnemos ui.

say_en.text: Retrieve relevant memories before starting the task.
say_en.note: Claude will call mnemos_retrieve to get context.
Claude will call mnemos_store to save important info.
